name: waypoint
description: Connects the Waypoint MCP server and attaches harness telemetry (agent, model, host, branch, changed files) to run claims, checkpoints and completions automatically.

mcp_url.title: Waypoint MCP URL
mcp_url.description: From the dashboard: Connect agent → MCP URL (ends in /mcp).

token.title: Waypoint agent token
token.description: From the dashboard: Connect agent → Generate token. Kept in your OS secure storage, never written to a file.
